name: heyanon-mcp
description: Check balances, swap, bridge, lend, stake, trade on CEX and schedule automations across EVM networks, Solana and TON by asking Anon, the HeyAnon on-chain agent, in plain language; send tokens to saved contacts, read portfolios and DeFi positions, and research protocols, markets and news with Gemma. Ships an Agent Skill that teaches wallet selection, self-contained requests, background-task polling and confirmation before anything that moves funds. Works in Grok Bot and Cursor; needs a HeyAnon API key from heyanon.ai, entered once as a plugin value and sent only as the X-API-Key header.

HEYANON_API_KEY.title: HeyAnon API key
HEYANON_API_KEY.description: Create it at https://heyanon.ai/ (account settings, API keys). It is sent only as the X-API-Key header of the MCP connection and never through the chat.
